usage: The word 本 is a measure word specifically used for books or book-like items.
It comes before the noun to indicate the quantity of books.
Unlike general counters, 本 is not used for loose papers or magazines, only bound materials like books or notebooks.
When counting books, put the number before 本 and then the noun, for example, '三本書' (three books).
本 can also be used as a classifier for some magazines or notebooks.
